responsible.title: Responsible Tourism
responsible.lead: Darjeeling is a fragile Himalayan ecosystem  2,000 metres of cloud forest, tea terraces and 600 bird species, held together by the families who live in it. Six commitments keep it that way.

principles.d: Carry reusable bottles, bags and cups. Every partner shop refills for free.
Choose homestays over chains. Your money reaches the family that hosts you.
Do not feed or chase wild animals. Observe from a distance and keep moving.
Walk marked trails only. Bushes take four years to recover from trampling.
Ask permission before photographing monasteries, rituals and people.
Keep noise low the hills and their creatures prefer it that way.

responsible.hero_caption: Cloud forest above Manebhanjan, photographed at first light.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: WBIN 1947 Studio LLP, under the name 1Darjeeling ("we," "us," "our," or "the Platform"), operates www.aanganerp.in (the "Site"), a local marketplace and travel guide connecting visitors with local businesses, guides, and services in Darjeeling. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your information when you use our Site.
By using 1Darjeeling, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

items: Account information: name, email address, phone number, password, and profile details when you register.

Role/onboarding information: details submitted during our onboarding questionnaire (e.g., whether you're a traveler, local business, guide, or other role), which may be used to assign badges or tiers on your profile.
Contact form submissions: any information you submit through contact or inquiry forms, including your message content.
Listing/business information: if you register as a local business or service provider, details such as business name, location, description, photos, pricing, and contact details.
Payment information: if applicable, payment details are processed by our third-party payment processor; we do not store full card details on our servers.
Communications: records of correspondence if you contact us directly.
Usage data: pages visited, time spent, click patterns, referring URLs.
Device and log data: IP address, browser type, device type, operating system, timestamps.
Cookies and similar technologies: used to remember preferences, maintain sessions, and analyze site usage (see Section 6).
Approximate location: derived from IP address or, if you grant permission, precise device location, to show relevant local listings.

sub.p: If you sign in via a third-party service (e.g., Google), we may receive basic profile information as permitted by that service.

sections.p: We use the information we collect to:
items: Create and manage your account and onboarding profile/badge tier
Connect travelers with local businesses, guides, and services
Operate, maintain, and improve the Site and its features
Respond to inquiries submitted through contact forms
Send administrative messages, updates, and (with consent, where required) marketing communications
Detect, prevent, and address technical issues, fraud, or abuse
Comply with legal obligations

sections.p: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information:
items: With local businesses/service providers: if you make an inquiry or booking, relevant details are shared with the business/provider you're contacting.
With service providers: hosting, database, analytics, and email providers who process data on our behalf under confidentiality obligations.
For legal reasons: if required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of 1Darjeeling, our users, or others.
Business transfers: in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.
With your consent: for any other purpose disclosed at the time you provide the information.

sections.p: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time (see Section 8).

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and access controls on our database. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
We use cookies and similar technologies to:
items: Keep you logged in
Remember your preferences
Understand how visitors use the Site (analytics)
sections.note: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some Site functionality.

sections.p: Our Site may contain links to third-party websites (e.g., local business websites, social media, booking partners). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

Correct inaccurate information
Request deletion of your account and data
Object to or restrict certain processing

Request a copy of your data in a portable format

sections.p: 1Darjeeling is for adults only. You must be at least 18 years old to create an account or make a booking request, as our Terms & Conditions require. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If you believe someone under 18 has given us information, please contact us so we can remove it.
If you access the Site from outside India, please note your information will be processed in India, where data protection laws may differ from those in your jurisdiction.

about.title: Built in Darjeeling, for Darjeeling.
about.lead: The hills already have everything a traveller needs. 1 Darjeeling simply puts it in one place, and makes sure the people who live here are the ones who benefit.
about.mission_body:
Across India, visitors arrive in towns and villages and end up booking through agents who have never walked these ridges. The homestay owner, the driver who knows every switchback, the shop weaving shawls upstairs, the cafe that has served the same breakfast for generations: they are hard to find online, and harder to book.

We put them on one map. No middlemen deciding who gets seen, no commission quietly taken out of a family's earnings.

pillars.d: Designed and built by a small team in Mirik, with homestay families, drivers and guides from these hills shaping every screen.
Nothing in aangan is tied to one town. Any place where local people host, drive, cook or guide can list and be booked the same way.
Every listing belongs to someone who lives where you travel. They write their own words, set their own price and keep what they earn.
No commission on any booking, ever. Providers pay one small yearly charge; the price they set is the price you see.

steps.d: Browse stays, drivers, guides, cafes, shops, festivals and nature near where you are going.
Ask to book a homestay, driver or guide in the app. For shops, cafes and events, get directions and go.
Every place you visit is someone's home. Leave it as you found it.

intro: 1Darjeeling is run by WBIN 1947 Studio LLP, a small team based in the Darjeeling hills. Whether you are a traveller with a question about a booking, a local business wanting to be listed, or someone with a complaint, this page tells you how to reach a person.

items: The mobile number registered to your account.

What you expected to happen, and what happened instead.
A screenshot, if something on screen looked wrong.

We will guide you through what is needed, including the documents required to verify your business.

Refund requests, questions about a fee, and reports of a duplicate charge should go to the address above with "Refund" in the subject line. Our Refund & Cancellation Policy sets out what is refundable and the timelines we work to.

In line with the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 and the Information Technology Rules, complaints that are not resolved through ordinary support can be escalated to our Grievance Officer.
items: Write to the address below with "Grievance" in the subject line.
Every grievance is acknowledged within 48 hours of receipt.
Every grievance is resolved within one month of receipt.
You will be given a reference for your complaint and told the outcome with reasons.

sub.h: 3.1 Traveller Pass — ₹1 a year, GST included, optional
sub.p: The pass is optional. A payment gives a traveller account one year with a verified badge that hosts see on its booking requests. With an active pass, sending booking requests is free; without it, each request costs ₹1.20 to send (see 3.2). Confirming a booking is free either way. sub.p: Sending a booking request to a business costs ₹1 plus 18% GST and a 2% payment gateway fee, ₹1.20 in all, paid to the Platform when you send it. With an active Traveller Pass, sending is free. Confirming a booking is free for everyone. The ₹1.20 is refunded in full, automatically, if the business declines the request or does not answer in time, if its dates go to another traveller who confirmed first, if you withdraw the request before confirming, or if the business or our team cancels the booking. sub.h: 3.3 Business Listing Plan — ₹499 a year for homestays, drivers and guides, ₹99 a year for cafés, each plus 18% GST and a 2% platform fee; free until 2 completed bookings; local shops list free

Once live, it takes bookings without paying until 2 bookings have been completed, meaning the guest's stay, ride or tour has taken place (for cafés, until 2 bookings or home-delivery orders have been completed or delivered). data_deletion.title: Delete Your Account & Data
intro: This page explains how to delete your 1Darjeeling account and what happens to your data when you do. It applies to both the 1 Darjeeling Android app and this website, which share one account.
You do not need the app installed to make this request, and you do not need to speak to anyone first. If you can sign in, deleting takes about thirty seconds and needs no approval from us.

sections.p: This is the fastest route and it is immediate  there is no queue and no review step.
items: Open the 1 Darjeeling app and go to the Profile tab.
Scroll to the bottom and tap Delete account.
Read the confirmation, which lists exactly what is about to be removed, then tap Delete permanently.
You are signed out straight away. The account is gone at that moment, not at the end of a notice period.

sections.p: If you have uninstalled the app, lost access to the phone number you signed up with, or would simply rather ask us, email the address at the bottom of this page from any address and tell us the phone number on the account.
items: We reply within 3 working days to confirm we have the request.

Because the account is identified by a phone number, we will send a one-time code to that number to confirm the request is yours. This is the only check we make, and it exists so that nobody can delete someone else's account by guessing their number.
The deletion itself is completed within 30 days of that confirmation, and in practice within a few days.
sections.note: If you cannot receive a code on that number any more, say so in your email and we will find another way to verify you rather than refusing the request.

sections.p: Deletion is permanent and it is not a deactivation. Everything below is removed outright from our systems, not hidden or flagged:
items: Your account: name, phone number, email address if you gave one, profile photo, language and interests.
Your bookings, past and upcoming, and the payment records attached to them.
Your saved stays, your reviews, and any referral history.
If you host or drive with us: your business profile, every listing you published, and the KYC identity documents you uploaded  both the records and the document files themselves.
Any one-time login codes still held against your phone number.
sections.note: Your listings disappear from the site as part of this, so a traveller cannot book something that no longer has anyone behind it.

sections.p: Two narrow categories survive deletion, in both cases because the law requires it of us rather than because we want them:
items: Transaction records that tax and accounting law obliges us to retain  the amount, the date and the invoice reference for money that actually moved. These are kept for 8 years as required, and are not linked back to a live account.
Records we have been formally required to preserve for an ongoing legal claim, dispute or investigation. If this applies to you we will tell you when you ask to delete.
sections.note: Nothing else is retained. We do not keep a shadow copy of a deleted profile, and we do not keep your account so that you can “reactivate” it later  if you come back, you start a new account.

sections.p: Our database backups are encrypted, are not readable as a browsable copy of your profile, and roll off on a 30-day cycle. A deleted account can therefore persist inside a backup image for up to 30 days after deletion. It is never restored into the live system, and it is overwritten automatically at the end of that cycle.

Deleting your account does not cancel a refund you are already owed. If a booking of yours is cancelled and a fee is due back, that refund is processed to the original payment method whether or not the account still exists. Delete first and it still reaches you.
For a deletion request, or any question about what we hold on you, write to us. This is also the grievance contact named in our Privacy Policy.
